title: Harborview pilot reaches full operation (synthetic fixture)
text: The Harborview Tidal Pilot reached full operation in 2021 after two years of construction. Engineers confirmed that the installed capacity of the Harborview Tidal Pilot is 12 megawatts. The total construction cost of the pilot was 84 million dollars. Annual electricity output averages 31 gigawatt-hours. The pilot requires periodic dredging of the shipping channel.
